scripts.desktop: node scripts/build-electron.mjs && concurrently -k -n server,web,app -c cyan,magenta,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5174 tcp:127.0.0.1:8765 && NODE_OPTIONS= ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron ."
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/fetch-win-sdk.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/fetch-win-sdk.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/fetch-win-sdk.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --win nsis --x64
